summary: 1. Total production landed within 1% of the daily target (22,754 BCM, -1.04%), but ore collapsed to -63.27% against target — the third near-zero ore day this fiscal cycle after Sep 5 (-90.6%) and Sep 8 (-93.7%), with the MTD ore cushion thinning from +10.39% (Sep 9) to +5.79% in a single day even as the total-line MTD gap itself narrowed slightly to -7.84%. 2. 2. Fleet-wide daily availability fell to 84.3% (core fleet 76.70%), driven by excavation dropping to 64.88% as EX-262 and EX-253 both stayed down the full 24 hours for a third straight day, joined by EX-340 and EX-263 losing several hours each to hydraulic and electric/aircon faults. 3. 3. A format check on [[fleet-availability-utilization]] found that the 112th-114th passes (Sep 7-9) omitted the per-fleet `| Fleet | Daily avail% | MTD avail% | Units | Total D.T hrs |` table this KB's own CLAUDE.md and the dashboard publish script both depend on — `publish_insights.py`'s `parse_fleet_au` function greps specifically for `| Excavator | ... |` and `| Dump Truck | ... |` table rows and takes the last match in the file, so without that table for three straight passes the published app's Excavator/Dump Truck fleet cards were almost certainly still showing Sep 6's stale figures (82.74%/91.90%) through the Sep 7-9 publish cycles. 4. The table is restored this pass. 5. Recommend a spot-check of the live app's fleet KPI cards to confirm whether they were in fact showing stale Sep 6 data through the Sep 7-9 publish windows, and to verify they now read Sep 10's 64.88%/91.85% figures once the next `wiki-insights-sync` publish runs. 6. EX-262's daily-report fault text still reads "Cylinder Change Out and Hydraulic System," unchanged since 08-Sep, despite a same-day (10-Sep) email from JRAR's Jacobus Swart naming the actual work as a boom-welding job — worth a direct check on whether the daily report's fault-code text ever gets corrected to match. 7. No new INX-SUM survey workbook has landed for two full compile passes (114th, 115th) — Day 16 (Sep 10) remains the in-progress reading logged on 2026-09-10, longer than this article's typical one-day filing lag. 8. Worth a direct check with survey on whether Day 16 is still open or simply hasn't been filed. 9. A new `RAW/CIP/` folder appeared this pass with one file (`RE_ adw-2026-059 Launch of the ADW Re-Focusing Program.eml`) — the first CIP-labeled material this KB has seen. Left unread and out of scope for this dashboard-scoped run; flagging as a judgment call on whether `RAW/CIP/` should be added to the Important References scan going forward, since its subject line suggests site-level program content rather than routine production data. [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] was not updated — no new INX-SUM survey workbook has landed since the 114th pass. Important References and the Notion Task Feedback Log were not checked this pass; both are explicitly out of scope for this task's instructions (owned by the full-compile protocol described in the KB's own CLAUDE.md). `publish_insights.py` was NOT run this pass, per Step 3 — the `wiki-insights-sync` task publishes separately at 11:00/17:00. No content removed or renamed from RAW.
